say:1:1323204001:0.text: Not many people come looking for me. I'm guessing Sergey sent you.
say:1:1323204001:0.source_cn: 很少有人会来找我，我猜你们是从谢尔盖那儿来的。

say:2:1323204002:0.text: Tell me, did he sneak off somewhere remote to fish and finally get eaten by the undead?
say:2:1323204002:0.source_cn: 说吧，是不是他偷偷去什么荒无人烟的地方钓鱼，终于被活死...

say:5:1323204005:1.text: OWW! That hurt! Don't do that again! What if you knock something loose?!
say:5:1323204005:1.source_cn: 哎哟！满满又说错话了，不要敲满满的头嘛！

say:6:1323204006:0.text: We're here on your husband's behalf to pick up his frosty meat.
say:6:1323204006:0.source_cn: 我们受您丈夫所托，来取他钓鱼用的寒霜腌肉。

say:7:1323204007:0.text: Ah, alright. I'll get some for you.
say:7:1323204007:0.male: Ah, alright. I'll get some for you.
say:7:1323204007:0.female: Ah, alright. I'll get some for you.

say:8:1323204008:0.text: This is all we have. Tell him to use it sparingly. Instead of hunting properly, all he does is fish. Now we barely have enough meat at home. And he feeds what little we have to fish!
say:8:1323204008:0.source_cn: 就这几块了，叫他省着点用吧，不好好打猎就知道钓鱼，家里...
say:8:1323204008:0.male: This is all we have. Tell him to use it sparingly. Instead of hunting properly, all he does is fish. Now we barely have enough meat at home. And he feeds what little we have to fish!
say:8:1323204008:0.female: This is all we have. Tell him to use it sparingly. Instead of hunting properly, all he does is fish. Now we barely have enough meat at home. And he feeds what little we have to fish!

say:10:1323204009:0.text: Judging by his reaction when asked about his catches, maybe he IS feeding fish instead of catching them...
say:10:1323204009:0.source_cn: 想起问到渔获数量时那个人的反应，说是喂鱼可能也没错……

choice_prompt:11:1323204009.text: Judging by his reaction when asked about his catches, maybe he IS feeding fish instead of catching them...
choice_prompt:11:1323204009.source_cn: 想起问到渔获数量时那个人的反应，说是喂鱼可能也没错……

say:12:1323204010:0.text: Not by miles. He's a hunter. He cures meat from his hunts, but we barely have enough to eat these days because he keeps using it for fishing.
say:12:1323204010:0.source_cn: 他哪儿是啊，他就是个打猎的，打猎来腌制好的肉家里都不够...
say:12:1323204010:0.male: Not by miles. He's a hunter. He cures meat from his hunts, but we barely have enough to eat these days because he keeps using it for fishing.
say:12:1323204010:0.female: Not by miles. He's a hunter. He cures meat from his hunts, but we barely have enough to eat these days because he keeps using it for fishing.

say:13:1323204012:0.text: And he's not even good at fishing! He never brings any fish home. It's more like he's just feeding them.
say:13:1323204012:0.source_cn: 说钓鱼吧，技术也不行，一天到晚都钓不回来一只，光看他喂鱼了。
say:13:1323204012:0.male: And he's not even good at fishing! He never brings any fish home. It's more like he's just feeding them.
say:13:1323204012:0.female: And he's not even good at fishing! He never brings any fish home. It's more like he's just feeding them.

say:14:1323204013:0.text: I bet the fish see him as a messenger of Dura, here to provide them with gifts.
say:14:1323204013:0.source_cn: 估计现在鱼一见了他啊，都觉着是女神的使者来馈赠它们了。
say:14:1323204013:0.male: I bet the fish see him as a messenger of Dura, here to provide them with gifts.
say:14:1323204013:0.female: I bet the fish see him as a messenger of Dura, here to provide them with gifts.

say:16:1323204011:0.text: Exactly! He's a hunter, but instead of bringing home food, he's wasting all the meat on fish!
say:16:1323204011:0.source_cn: 可不是嘛，他是个猎人，打猎来腌制好的肉家里都不够吃，还...
say:16:1323204011:0.male: Exactly! He's a hunter, but instead of bringing home food, he's wasting all the meat on fish!
say:16:1323204011:0.female: Exactly! He's a hunter, but instead of bringing home food, he's wasting all the meat on fish!
